name: Sand City South
description: Sand City Brewing's large Lindenhurst taproom near the train station. Its stage hosts weekend cover bands, indie and punk shows, comedy and themed music nights.

dancing.notes: The tasting room is big, with an open floor plan and a stage. Cover bands often play on weekends, and one visitor wrote that a band had the crowd dancing and singing all night. We could not confirm a marked dance floor.

evidence.note: Visitor reviews mention weekend live music and say a cover band had the place dancing and singing all night.
Concert listings and fan reviews for shows at the Lindenhurst brewery; one fan notes it now has a stage.
Venue overview: live music, comedy and community events, with room to mingle between sets.
